chapters.label: The run, live
chapters.text: Sweden, 1958. Brazil lead Austria one-nil. Left-back Nílton Santos wins the ball in his own half, passes to Altafini, and keeps running. The ball comes back... he scores!

chapters.label: Get back!
chapters.text: Watch again. Back then, full-backs rarely crossed halfway. Coach Feola shouted, 'Get back! Get back!' But Nílton kept running.

chapters.label: Well done
chapters.text: The return pass... he shoots... goal! Two-nil. And Feola just said, 'Well done.'

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn. Defenders can attack too! Space in front of you? Bring the ball forward, pass, and keep running!
